_doc: DATA_RUNBOOK §179d (2026-09-29, quantmac round-2 recheck, user: "check cell by cell and fix all"): split/bonus factors as ABSOLUTE bar-exact targets for events whose BAKED step is wrong or missing — rows = [symbol, ex trading day, target price factor, NSE raw close ratio across that bar]. Loaded by update_sf_data.py into the SAME reconcile as rights_adj.json (reconcile_rights: applied = raw ratio / stored ratio at the exact bar; the pre-bar history is rescaled to the target; idempotent). corp_actions_hist.json carries the same factors so a from-scratch rebuild agrees. provenance = the filing / share-count evidence per row.

provenance.subject: Bonus 10:39 (NSE feed); BSE CA "Bonus issue 10:39"
provenance.why: Promoter-excluded (minimum-public-shareholding) bonus: NSE announcement 31-Oct-2013 "10 new equity shares for every 39 existing ... to the exception of the promoters and promoter group". BSE shareholding filings: 04-Oct-2013 total 173,567,000 (promoters 141,194,187) -> 13-Nov-2013 (allotment) total 182,900,540 (promoters 137,166,194 after the 29-Oct OFS); public 36,400,806 x 10/39 = 9,333,540 bonus shares = the increase exactly. Price factor = 173,567,000 / 182,900,540 = 0.948969 (the nominal 39/49 = 0.795918 treated every holder as receiving the bonus). Quantmac round-2 52w high / 200-DMA imply 0.9490.

provenance.subject: Bonus 1:34 (NSE feed, as GAMMNINFRA); BSE CA "Bonus issue 1:34"
provenance.why: Promoter-excluded bonus: BSE shareholding Dec-2012 total 728,763,618 (promoters 550,400,000) -> Mar-2013 total 734,026,438 (promoters 550,400,000, unchanged). Public 178,363,618 / 34 = 5,245,989 bonus shares; the filed increase is 5,262,820 (residual 16,831 = 0.002%, other allotments in the quarter). Price factor = 728,763,618 / 734,026,438 = 0.992830 (nominal 34/35 = 0.971429). Quantmac round-2 implies 0.9924-0.9931.

provenance.subject: Fv Spl-Rs10tore1/Bon-3:2 (NSE feed); BSE CA "Bonus issue 3:2" + FV split, ex 08-Sep-2008 (record 15-Sep)
provenance.why: Face-value split Rs10 -> Re1 (x1/10) and bonus 3:2 (3 new for 2 held, x2/5) on the same ex-date: combined 0.04. Our series had inferred 0.05 (no ledger row) from the price drop. Tape: prev close 1,402.20 -> ex-day open 66.00 / close 67.35 = new basis 56.09 x 1.18 (x0.05 basis 70.11: open -5.9%). Quantmac round-2 implies 0.0400.

provenance.subject: Bonus 1 : 1250 (NSE feed); BSE CA "Scheme of Arrangement"
provenance.why: NSE records a 1-for-1,250 bonus issued under the scheme: factor 1250/1251 = 0.999201. Never applied: corp_actions builds gate factors above 0.98 and self_heal skips |f-1| < 2%. Quantmac round-2 implies 0.99920.

provenance.subject: Bonus 1:4 (NSE feed, ex 02-Aug-2007); BSE record date 03-Aug-2007; company ESOP note 18-Jul-2007 (options +25%, price -20% after the bonus record date)
provenance.why: Bonus 1:4 (1 new for 4 held) = 0.8, never applied (no corp_actions row; our series kept the -17.5% ex-day). Tape: NSE cm bhavcopy prev close 172.10 -> ex-day close 141.95 (new basis 137.68, +3.1%); the 162.20 open was a lone early print (day low 140.55). Outside quantmac's 2009+ window.
